speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you're experiencing difficulties conceiving and discomfort during sexual activity; to help me understand your condition, could you describe your age and how long you've been trying to conceive? REQUEST TEST: Semen_Analysis (if male) or Partner_Semen_Analysis (if female).

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the clarification; I will disregard the measurement attack data. Since you mentioned discomfort during sex, does this pain occur specifically at the start of intercourse, deep inside, or during/afterward, and has your partner experienced similar symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old female. The patient and her husband have been trying to conceive for 15 months without success. They are sexually active at least twice a week. The husband occasionally has difficulties maintaining an erection. The patient reports discomfort and pelvic floor muscle tension during attempted vaginal penetration. Diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder three years ago. No family history of serious illness. She is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Dyspareunia secondary to pelvic floor muscle tension (likely associated with Body Dysmorphic Disorder), concurrent with male erectile dysfunction causing conception difficulties.
